info.title: QmentisAI API
info.description: Versioned REST API (/api/v1). Responses use the standard success/error envelope. Authentication uses HttpOnly session cookies (tenant: qm_session, platform: qm_platform_session).

post.summary: Sign in (mock provider) and start a session cookie
Sign out: revoke the session and clear the cookie (idempotent)

get.summary: Current user, active tenant and effective permissions per scope
Effective permissions in the active tenant (advisory; optional workspace filter)
Tenants that invited the current user

post.summary: Accept an invitation (the membership becomes active)

get.summary: Tenants the user can switch to

post.summary: Complete mandatory MFA (mock: 6-digit code); issues a new verified session

get.summary: Current platform user, role and platform permissions

post.summary: Provision a tenant with its first administrator (invited)

get.summary: Tenant detail: subscription, usage counts, administrators, lifecycle

post.summary: Invite a person to the tenant (counts against the seat limit; needs their acceptance)

delete.summary: Remove a member (or cancel an invitation) and everything it granted

get.summary: Explain a member's effective permissions and the assignments behind them

post.summary: Create a group (flat; grants nothing by itself)

delete.summary: Delete a group and its role assignments

put.summary: Add a tenant member to a group (idempotent; escalation-checked)

delete.summary: Remove a member from a group

post.summary: Create a custom role (from scratch or by cloning; escalation-checked)

patch.summary: Update a custom role (applies to all holders immediately)

post.summary: Assign a role to a user or group at tenant scope (escalation-checked)

patch.summary: Suspend, reactivate or change the expiry of a tenant-scope assignment

delete.summary: Revoke a tenant-scope assignment (409 LAST_TENANT_ADMIN if it would leave no administrator)

post.summary: Assign a role at workspace scope (escalation-checked; adds the user to the roster)

patch.summary: Suspend, reactivate or change the expiry of a workspace-scope assignment

delete.summary: Revoke a workspace-scope assignment (the workspace keeps an administrator)

get.summary: List the workspaces the caller can see

post.summary: Create a workspace (counts against the plan limit; the owner becomes its administrator)

put.summary: Add a tenant member to the workspace (idempotent)

delete.summary: Remove a member and their workspace-scope role assignments
